relations.subject: Joseph de Guignes
relations.evidence: he was accepted as a student by the Sinologist Etienne Fourmont in 1736.

relations.subject: Joseph de Guignes
relations.evidence: When Fourmont died in December 1745 de Guignes succeeded him at Royal Library, where his title was “sécrétaire-interprète pour les langues orientales”.
